facts.fact: 醒来场景：昏迷数小时后醒来，Silas 已去找 Ezekiel 和 Magnus 谈话；Astrid 与 Maya 在书堆里研究。
facts.anchor: You’ve been in and out of consciousness for a couple of hours now.

facts.fact: Astrid 交底：他差点杀了所有人——全靠 Emerson 重织 Dilethisante 快过他的毁灭，加上 Adrien 把他劝停。
facts.anchor: The only reason we’re alive is because you rewrote Dilethisante faster than he could destroy it

facts.fact: Maya 认账：她把 Adrien 赶出了公寓——因为「他去年不是想杀你吗，我能怎么想」；Astrid 补刀：他确实该挨点骂（literally trying to murder you）。
facts.anchor: “Well, he did try to kill you last year, didn’t he? What was I supposed to think?”

facts.fact: 细节：Adrien 夜宿的扶手椅留下了麦芽威士忌、肉桂与香草的气味；三女没干净杯子直接对瓶喝。
facts.anchor: relishing the scent of malt whiskey, cinnamon, and vanilla that now marked the armchair as the location where Adrien slept every night

facts.fact: 解谜主线：儿童书 Enclave of Aelwyth and Dweorunn 里画着 Henry Devereaux——1386 A.D. 消失的议事会成员（书封的亮片小精灵会动）。
facts.anchor: Bit of a wallflower as far as Council members go, but he disappeared in the latter part of the 14th century.

facts.fact: 历史修正：1386＝Magnus 屠灭整个议事会之年——但 Henry 那晚根本不在场；他再没出现，众人只当是死于逃亡或被后来补杀。
facts.anchor: But it looks like Henry Devereaux wasn’t actually at the Council meeting the night Magnus murdered them all.

facts.fact: 揭底：Maya 上周找到的玻璃穹顶沉睡老人就是 Henry——他在 Enclave 里待了六百多年，只剩尸体般被保存。
facts.anchor: Because last week Maya found Henry. He’s been in this book the whole time.

facts.fact: 结论升级：议事会重建后馆长可能只是傀儡，实权者一直在幕后操作——「我们可能一直瞄错了敌人」。
facts.anchor: We may have our sights set on the wrong enemy.
